verdict.rationale: Brex's docs reference budget controls, Team API for managing users/roles, and AI-powered invoice approval/payment automation, implying some approval workflow capability, but there is no explicit documentation of configuring granular approval permissions for designated teammates or a one-click approve-and-send payment action. Missing for 10: explicit approval-permission configuration UI, evidence of 'one-click' payment approval flow, and multi-approver role documentation.
